mapper.select: select p.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, p.time_zone, p.sort_no, p.use_yn, p.row_ver from sys_plant p where p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.sort_no, p.plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select i.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, i.use_yn from mst_item i where i.item_cd = #{itemCd}

select r.routing_id as id, r.rev, r.alt_no, r.valid_from, r.valid_to from mst_routing r where r.item_id = #{itemId} and r.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and r.status = 'RELEASED' and r.valid_from <= #{date} and (r.valid_to is null or #{date} < r.valid_to) order by r.alt_no

select b.bom_id as id, b.rev, b.alt_no, b.valid_from, b.valid_to from mst_bom b where b.item_id = #{itemId} and b.status = 'RELEASED' and b.valid_from <= #{date} and (b.valid_to is null or #{date} < b.valid_to) order by b.alt_no

select l.line_id, o.order_no, l.line_no, c.cust_nm, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, l.due_date from sal_order_line l join sal_order o on o.order_id = l.order_id join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id where l.item_id = #{itemId} and l.status = 'OPEN' order by l.due_date, o.order_no, l.line_no limit 200
select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm from mst_equip e where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y' order by e.equip_cd
select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm from mst_equip e where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and e.equip_cd = #{equipCd} and e.use_yn = 'Y'
select r.routing_id as id, r.item_id, r.plant_cd, r.status, r.valid_from, r.valid_to from mst_routing r where r.routing_id = #{id}
select b.bom_id as id, b.item_id, b.status, b.valid_from, b.valid_to, b.base_qty from mst_bom b where b.bom_id = #{id}

select b.bom_id as id, b.item_id, b.status, b.valid_from, b.valid_to, b.base_qty from mst_bom b where b.item_id = #{itemId} and b.alt_no = 1 and b.status = 'RELEASED' and b.valid_from <= #{date} and (b.valid_to is null or #{date} < b.valid_to)
mapper.sql: w.wo_id, w.wo_no, w.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, w.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, trim_scale(w.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, w.unit_cd, w.plan_start, w.plan_end, w.routing_id, r.rev as routing_rev, w.bom_id, b.rev as bom_rev, w.order_line_id, o.order_no, ol.line_no as order_line_no, c.cust_nm, w.priority, w.status, w.released_at, w.released_by, w.cancel_reason, w.remark, (select count(*) from prd_wo_proc x where x.wo_id = w.wo_id) as proc_cnt, w.row_ver, w.updated_at, w.updated_by

from prd_wo w join sys_plant p on p.comp_cd = w.comp_cd and p.plant_cd = w.plant_cd join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id join mst_routing r on r.routing_id = w.routing_id left join mst_bom b on b.bom_id = w.bom_id left join sal_order_line ol on ol.line_id = w.order_line_id left join sal_order o on o.order_id = ol.order_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id
mapper.select:
select
order by
w.wo_no desc i.item_cd desc w.plan_end desc w.priority desc w.status desc w.plan_start desc ,
w.wo_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select count(*) from prd_wo w

select
where w.wo_id = #{id}
select status from prd_wo where wo_id = #{id} for update

insert into prd_wo (comp_cd, wo_no, plant_cd, item_id, plan_qty, unit_cd, plan_start, plan_end, routing_id, bom_id, order_line_id, priority, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{woNo}, #{f.plantCd}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.planQty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.planStart}, #{f.planEnd}, #{f.routingId}, #{f.bomId}, #{f.orderLineId}, #{f.priority}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning wo_id
mapper.update: update prd_wo set plan_qty = #{f.planQty}, plan_start = #{f.planStart}, plan_end = #{f.planEnd}, routing_id = #{f.routingId}, bom_id = #{f.bomId}, order_line_id = #{f.orderLineId}, priority = #{f.priority}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'PLANNED'

update prd_wo set plan_start = #{f.planStart}, plan_end = #{f.planEnd}, priority = #{f.priority}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status in ('RELEASED', 'IN_PROGRESS')

update prd_wo set status = 'RELEASED', released_at = now(), released_by = #{by}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'PLANNED'
mapper.insert: insert into prd_wo_proc (comp_cd, wo_id, op_seq, proc_id, proc_cd, proc_nm, node_id, std_ct_sec, units_per_cycle, setup_min, src_step_id, created_by, updated_by) select hb_current_comp(), #{woId}, s.op_seq, s.proc_id, p.proc_cd, p.proc_nm, s.node_id, s.std_ct_sec, s.units_per_cycle, s.setup_min, s.step_id, #{by}, #{by} from mst_routing_step s join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = s.proc_id where s.routing_id = #{routingId} order by s.op_seq

insert into prd_wo_param (comp_cd, wo_proc_id, param_cd, param_nm, unit_nm, target_val, lsl, usl, sort_no) select hb_current_comp(), wp.wo_proc_id, m.param_cd, m.param_nm, m.unit_nm, m.target_val, m.lsl, m.usl, m.sort_no from prd_wo_proc wp join mst_routing_param m on m.step_id = wp.src_step_id where wp.wo_id = #{woId}
mapper.select: select l.line_id, l.bom_id, l.item_id, i.item_cd, l.line_type, l.qty, l.unit_cd, i.unit_cd as item_unit, coalesce(c.factor, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 end) as factor, l.scrap_pct, l.fixed_yn, l.issue_method, l.op_seq, l.alt_grp, l.alt_priority, l.alt_pct from mst_bom_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_unit_conv c on c.item_id = l.item_id and c.from_unit = l.unit_cd and c.to_unit = i.unit_cd and c.use_yn = 'Y' where l.bom_id = #{bomId} order by l.line_no, l.line_id
mapper.insert:
insert into prd_wo_bom (comp_cd, wo_id, seq, item_id, line_type, req_qty, unit_cd, op_seq, issue_method, alt_grp, alt_priority, alt_pct, src_bom_id, src_line_id, src_qty, src_unit_cd, scrap_pct, phantom_path) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{woId}, #{l.seq}, #{l.itemId}, #{l.lineType}, #{l.reqQty}, #{l.unitCd}, #{l.opSeq}, #{l.issueMethod}, #{l.altGrp}, #{l.altPriority}, #{l.altPct}, #{l.srcBomId}, #{l.srcLineId}, #{l.srcQty}, #{l.srcUnitCd}, #{l.scrapPct}, #{l.phantomPath})
mapper.sql: wp.wo_proc_id, wp.op_seq, wp.proc_cd, wp.proc_nm, wp.node_id, h.node_cd, trim_scale(wp.std_ct_sec)::text as std_ct_sec, wp.units_per_cycle, trim_scale(wp.setup_min)::text as setup_min, wp.status, wp.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, wp.row_ver
mapper.select: select from prd_wo_proc wp left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = wp.node_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = wp.equip_id where wp.wo_id = #{woId} order by wp.op_seq
select from prd_wo_proc wp left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = wp.node_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = wp.equip_id where wp.wo_proc_id = #{id}
select wo_id from prd_wo_proc where wo_proc_id = #{id}

select p.wo_proc_id, p.param_cd, p.param_nm, p.unit_nm, trim_scale(p.target_val)::text as target_val, trim_scale(p.lsl)::text as lsl, trim_scale(p.usl)::text as usl from prd_wo_param p join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = p.wo_proc_id where wp.wo_id = #{woId} order by wp.op_seq, p.sort_no, p.param_cd

select b.seq, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, b.line_type, trim_scale(b.req_qty)::text as req_qty, b.unit_cd, b.op_seq, b.issue_method, b.alt_grp, b.alt_priority, trim_scale(b.alt_pct)::text as alt_pct, trim_scale(b.src_qty)::text as src_qty, b.src_unit_cd, trim_scale(b.scrap_pct)::text as scrap_pct, b.phantom_path from prd_wo_bom b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.wo_id = #{woId} order by b.seq
mapper.update: update prd_wo_proc set equip_id = #{equipId}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where wo_proc_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status <> 'DONE'
